race.comment: OVER YONDER (1) is the one to beat after holding his form in BM68 Saturday company at Morphettville, where he was fifth to Delightful Shecky after jumping awkwardly, racing keenly and striking interference on the home turn. His third to Bred 'Em All two runs back reads well, the easier company suits, and the 1.5kg claim helps offset the big weight. STRAWBERRY SWING (10) brings the clearest winning form from this track, having scored dominantly in BM54 grade on soft ground, though this is a stronger test. CHESTERAY (4) has to rebound from a plain run at the latest, but his prior win over 1000m at this venue keeps him firmly in calculations. LAVA LAD (3) is another genuine danger with two wins and two placings from nine starts at this track and distance, and he looks well placed third-up after closing off from well back in BM64 grade last start.
